notes_for_editor: Only the provincial tower-layer record names this tower. Two WebSearch calls, one Wikipedia search and the lookout directories (Canada's Fire Lookouts index, Canada Lookouts Ontario list, the forestrangers still-standing list of 159 towers) returned no Bullbrook entry. The record has no height, construction date, agency or status, so the story says almost nothing about the tower itself and sits below the usual 120-word floor. Context paragraph is province-wide, not specific to this tower. Editor may prefer to hold the story until a history source turns up (the Forest History Ontario archives or a local history group for the 47.34 N, 82.82 W area).
